title: "नैकापे सर्किनी’’ कथामा सबाल्टर्र्न (सिमान्तीयता) {The Subaltern (Marginality) in the Story of "Naikape Sarkini"}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख पारिजातको ‘नैकापे सर्किनी’ कथामा सबाल्टर्न अध्ययन विश्लेषणसँग सम्बन्धित छ । एन्टोनिओ ग्राम्सीले उत्तर औपनिवेशिक उपभोक्तावादी संस्कृतिको सन्दर्भमा सबाल्टर्न शब्दलाई शासित वर्गको वकालत गर्ने क्रममा हैकम वा प्रभुत्वको नवीन अर्थसँग पनि जोडेर प्रयोग गरेपछि यसले साहित्यको क्षेत्रमा प्रवेश पाएको हो । ग्राम्सीका शब्दमा सबाल्टर्न भन्नाले गैरशासकीय र अहैकमवादी वर्गलाई जनाउँछ, जो सधैँ अधीनस्थ, पराधीन हुन्छन् । सबाल्टर्न सांस्कृतिक र साहित्यसँग सम्बन्धित अन्तर्विषयक अध्ययन हो । सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनभित्र विविध पक्षहरू समेटिन्छन् । तीमध्ये सबाल्टर्न अध्ययन महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष हो । सबाल्टर्न शब्दले समाजमा विभिन्न अवसरबाट पछाडि पारिएको वर्ग, तह, लिङ्ग, जात तथा समूहलाई जनाउँछ । सबाल्टर्न अध्ययनलाई कथाको सामाजिक संरचना, सीमान्तीकृत वर्ग, प्रभुत्वशाली समूह र विचार धारासँग जोडेर हेर्नु सान्दर्भिक मानिन्छ । प्रस्तुत कथामा सामन्ती तथा पितृसतात्मक समाजमा निम्नवर्गका महिलाहरू माथि हुने शोषण, लैङ्गिक विभेदका मुद्दालाई यथार्थ रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यहाँ सोही सिद्धान्तलाई आधार मानेर पारिजातको ‘नैकापे सर्किनी’ कथामा सबाल्टर्न विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत लेख तयार पार्नका लागि प्राथमिक तथा द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्रीहरू पुस्तकालयबाट अध्ययन गरी सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । सङ्कलित सामग्रीहरूलाई विश्लेषण गर्ने आधार सबाल्टर्न सम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई लिइएको छ । यसमा निगमनात्मक तथा पाठविश्लेषण विश्लेषण विधिको उपयोग गरी साक्ष्यहरुका आधारमा कथामास बाल्र्टनको वर्गीय, जातीय, लैङ्गिक अवस्था, सबाल्र्टनको प्रतिरोधी चतना तथा लेखकीय दृष्टिकोणको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसमा सन्दर्भ सामग्रीहरूको प्रयोगमा ए.पि. ए. पद्धति अपनाइएको छ ।
american_english: This article is related to the study and analysis of the subaltern in Parijat's story "Naikape Sarkini." The term "subaltern" gained entry into the field of literature after Antonio Gramsci, in the context of postcolonial consumerist culture, used it while advocating for the ruled class by also linking it to a new meaning of hegemony or dominance. In Gramsci's words, the subaltern refers to the non-ruling and non-hegemonic class, who are always subordinate and subjugated. Subaltern study is an interdisciplinary study related to culture and literature. Various aspects are encompassed within cultural studies. Among these, subaltern study is an important aspect. The word "subaltern" denotes the class, stratum, gender, caste, and group that have been left behind from various opportunities in society. It is considered relevant to examine subaltern studies in connection with the story's social structure, marginalized class, dominant group, and ideology. In the present story, the issues of exploitation and gender discrimination against lower-class women in a feudal and patriarchal society are realistically presented. Here, taking that very theory as a foundation, a subaltern analysis is carried out on Parijat's story "Naikape Sarkini." To prepare this article, primary and secondary source materials were studied and collected from the library. The theoretical tenets of the subaltern are taken as the basis for analyzing the collected materials. Utilizing deductive and textual analysis methods, this study analyzes the subaltern's class, caste, and gender status, the subaltern's resistant consciousness, and the authorial perspective in the story on the basis of textual evidence. In this, the APA style has been adopted for the use of reference materials.

In Gramsci's own words, the subaltern means the non-ruling and non-hegemonic class who are always subordinate and under someone else's thumb. Subaltern inquiry is an interdisciplinary study tied up with culture and literature. All kinds of aspects get covered inside cultural studies. Among them, subaltern study is definitely a major aspect. The word "subaltern" points to the class, social layer, gender, caste, and group left behind from various opportunities in society. It makes total sense to look at subaltern studies in connection with the story's social structure, marginalised class, dominant groups, and ideology. In the present story, the issues of exploitation and gender discrimination against lower-class women in a feudal and patriarchal society are presented true to life. Here, taking that very theory as a foundation, a subaltern analysis is carried out on Parijat's story "Naikape Sarkini." To get this article together, primary and secondary source materials were studied and gathered straight from the library. The theoretical tenets of the subaltern are taken as the basis for analysing the collected materials. Using deductive and textual analysis methods, this study analyses the subaltern's class, caste, and gender status, the subaltern's resistant consciousness, and the author's viewpoint in the story based on evidence. In this, the APA style has been adopted for using reference materials.
